metas.name: ★ 8.5 · 2014 · Whiplash
metas.description: A promising young drummer enrolls at a cut-throat music conservatory where his dreams of greatness are mentored by an instructor who will stop at nothing to realize a student's potential.

metas.name: ★ 8.4 · 2011 · Samsara
metas.description: Filmed over nearly five years in twenty-five countries on five continents, and shot on seventy-millimetre film, Samsara transports us to the varied worlds of sacred grounds, disaster zones, industrial complexes, and natural wonders.

metas.name: ★ 8.2 · 2012 · Searching for Sugar Man
metas.description: Two South Africans set out to discover what happened to their unlikely musical hero, the mysterious 1970s rock n roller, Rodriguez.

metas.name: ★ 8.0 · 2016 · La La Land
metas.description: When Sebastian, a pianist, and Mia, an actress, follow their passion and achieve success in their respective fields, they find themselves torn between their love for each other and their careers.
